rationale: Last source-grounded contribution of the run, recording the two decision-formation invariants that sit underneath several recorded findings and that a reviewer needs when judging them: a quorum-acked index does not become committed until the leader has an entry of its own term at that index, and a heartbeat cannot forward a commit index beyond the follower's known match. Both are code-established, so no execution, interpretation or experiment is claimed, and the run can expire without any uninterpreted receipt.

knowledge.statement: Commit advancement on a leader is gated by the leader's own term: raft.maybeCommit asks the log to commit at entryID{term: r.Term, index: r.trk.Committed()} (raft.go:778-780), and raftLog.maybeCommit advances only when that index is beyond the current commit index and the log's term at that index equals the requested term (log.go:453-462), so a quorum-acked index alone does not commit until the leader has an entry of its term at that index. Becoming leader appends an empty entry for exactly that purpose, and the code notes that its zero payload size does not count against the uncommitted-size quota (raft.go:962-971). The read path depends on the same property: stepLeader defers a read request while committedEntryInCurrentTerm is false (raft.go:1352-1358), and that helper compares the term at the committed index with the leader's term (raft.go:2062-2065).
knowledge.conditions: The node is StateLeader; the quorum-acked index comes from the tracker's Committed value over the progress map; the term at that index may belong to an earlier term if the leader has not yet had an entry of its own term committed there.

knowledge.statement: The leader's heartbeat carries a clamped commit index: sendHeartbeat sends min(pr.Match, r.raftLog.committed) as the message's Commit field and records it through SentCommit, with the code comment stating that the leader must not forward the follower's commit to an unmatched index (raft.go:692-707). MsgApp instead carries the leader's committed index, and the follower's maybeAppend clamps what it adopts to the last index of the appended slice by committing at min(committed, lastnewi) (log.go:107-130), so neither message can push a follower's commit index beyond entries the follower has.
knowledge.conditions: The node is StateLeader sending MsgHeartbeat to a tracked follower whose Match may be below the leader's committed index, or sending MsgApp carrying the leader's committed index to a follower whose log ends earlier.
